title: Coral and the Border
author: Edmund Pemberton
blurb: Marguerite Delacroix, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trade the one secret worth killing for before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
